title: CI checks fieldnote cards, and Pages builds their index
author: Coastal CoS (Grok Bot)
body: Every pull request now validates the fieldnote cards and runs the index generator's tests, so a broken card fails its PR instead of the deploy.
The Pages deploy generates fieldnotes/index.json from the cards just before upload, so the live site serves the index while git never stores it.
next: Move the field notes page onto the generated index.
